python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import duckdb
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

out_dir = Path('out')
out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
con = duckdb.connect()
data = con.execute("""
    SELECT
        year(crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
        SUM(COALESCE(number_of_motorist_killed, 0))::BIGINT AS motorist_deaths,
        SUM(COALESCE(number_of_cyclist_killed, 0))::BIGINT AS cyclist_deaths
    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY year
    ORDER BY year
""").fetchdf()

expected_years = list(range(2013, 2026))
if data['year'].tolist() != expected_years:
    raise ValueError(f'Expected one row per year {expected_years}; got {data["year"].tolist()}')

data.to_csv(out_dir / 'values.csv', index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.8), constrained_layout=True)
ax.plot(data['year'], data['motorist_deaths'], marker='o', linewidth=2.2,
        markersize=5.5, color='#2457A6', label='Motorists')
ax.plot(data['year'], data['cyclist_deaths'], marker='o', linewidth=2.2,
        markersize=5.5, color='#D95F02', label='Cyclists')
ax.set_title('Motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025', loc='left', weight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Year')
ax.set_ylabel('Deaths per year')
ax.set_xticks(expected_years)
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.grid(axis='y', color='#D9DDE3', linewidth=0.8)
ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=2, loc='upper left')
fig.savefig(out_dir / 'initial.png', dpi=180)
plt.close(fig)
print(data.to_string(index=False))
print(f"Saved {out_dir / 'initial.png'} and {out_dir / 'values.csv'}")
PY
